title: 2030 — First kitchen hulls products reach price parity: taste illusions
definition: 2030 milestone on the Taste Hacking Kitchens roadmap.
description:
First kitchen hulls products reach price parity: taste illusions cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the taste illusions results have to replicate outside the lab, kitchen logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and sensory science operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed taste illusions demonstrations, kitchen logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting sensory science uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Taste Hacking Kitchens Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Taste Hacking Kitchens: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Taste Hacking Kitchens — kitchens hacking taste perception.

Phase 1 — Prove (taste illusions): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (kitchen logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sensory science): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (menu design): kitchen hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and restaurants-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
